missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Фамилия' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Редкая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it. A clean introduction to this feminine noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Фамилию' is the accusative object of 'забыл'; feminine -ия nouns take -ию here. 'Его' is the unchanging possessive. A common everyday confession.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Фамилии' is the genitive used with the negated verb 'не помню'. Feminine -ия nouns take -ии in the genitive singular. 'Её' is the unchanging possessive.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Фамилии' is the dative governed by 'доверять', which takes a dative object. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative, matching the -ия pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Фамилией' is the instrumental governed by 'гордиться', which takes the instrumental for the thing one is proud of. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Фамилии' is the prepositional form after 'в'; feminine -ия nouns take -ии here. 'Ошибка' is the nominative subject of 'есть'.
Strategic focus: Accusative in a request. 'Фамилию' is the accusative object of the imperative 'назовите'. 'Вашу' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'пожалуйста' adds politeness.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Фамилии' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'были'. 'Незнакомые' agrees as a plural adjective, and 'в списке' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Фамилии' is the accusative plural of 'записал'; as an inanimate noun it keeps the nominative-plural form. 'Все эти' agree in the plural.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural with a possession frame. 'Фамилии' is the nominative-plural thing possessed. 'У многих студентов' uses the genitive plural after 'у', and 'одинаковые' agrees in the plural.
